answer: Yarrow judges post tundra puzzles each epoch and mint one ivory to a key for every solution they accept. Yarrow also compares solutions to the same tundra puzzle and links keys whose answers match beyond chance. A key may bid on jobs only after earning ivory equal to its rank in its linked cluster. An operator's k-th key must earn k ivory, so an honest newcomer earns 1. An operator with 100 clones must earn 5,050 ivory of judged work, unless it runs a separately trained model behind each clone.
